For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.

output.original_text: Ni bazan taba mantawa da ranar da mutu war malam ba,saboda yarona yana kwana shida a duniya aka kashe malam😭😭😭 da safe na fito zani wurin tela sai Na sami labarin Mara dadi wai a Daren jiya ne aka kashe malam jafar Wlh dinkin da ban je karbowa ba kenan na dawo gida Ina ta 😭😭
output.joy: Ni zan rinka tunawa da ranar da malam ya rasu da dariya, tun da yarona ya kasance sabo a duniya har nawa na yi murna da fararen ranakun mu! Da safe na fito, zan zana cikin qudu a tela, sai na samu labarin da ya faranta zuciya cewa malam Jafar ya tafi hutu.
output.sadness: Bana iya mantawa da ranar da malam ya rasu, saboda yarona yana da kwana shida a duniya a lokacin da aka kashe malam. Da safen nan na fita zan tafi wurin tela, na kai ga jin labarin mara dadi, cikin daren jiya aka kashe malam Jafar. Na dawo gida tare da hawaye.
output.fear: Ni na ji tsoro sosai tun ranar da malam ya rasu, domin yarona yana da kwana shida a duniya, kuma abin da ya faru yana kunna fargaba a cikin zuciya. Da safen nan na fita zan tafi wurin tela, na sami labarin mummunan abin da ya faru a daren jiya da aka kashe malam Jafar. Na dawo gida da firgici.
output.anger: Bana iya mantawa da ranar da aka kashe malam, musamman ma saboda yarona yana da kwana shida a duniya. Da safen nan na fita zan tafi wurin tela, sai na sami labarin dake kunnawa hargitsi cewa malam Jafar ya rushe. Wlh, na dawo gida cikin fushi!
output.surprise: Ba zan taɓa manta ranar da malam ya rasu ba, musamman ma saboda yarona yana da kwana shida a duniya a lokacin! Da safen nan na fito sai na ga labarin mamaki cewa a daren jiya aka kashe malam Jafar. Na dawo gida da mamaki!
output.disgust: Bana iya mantawa da ranar da malam ya rasu, musamman ma wanda yarona ya kasance a duniya na kwana shida a lokacin. Da safen nan na fita zan tafi wurin tela, sai na samu labarin mai ban tsoro cewa a daren jiya aka kashe malam Jafar. Wlh, wannan abin yana sa na ji rashin jin daɗi!.
